_doc: tau2-bench airline instance. Evolve set = tau2's train split (30 tasks), held-out = its test split; S = fraction of trials with reward 1 (database equals gold AND all required info said) over 30 x k = 60 trials; C = policy tokens per trial. Policy and user simulator: deepseek-v4-flash, thinking off; proposer / analyst / critic: deepseek-v4-pro, thinking off (rrsi/llm.py maps the upstream model names). Selection constants follow the upstream coding instance rescaled to this trial count: beta1 = 0.25 / (1/60) (25% more tokens per additional solved trial), w_s = 0 (inside the noise band only a token saving or a new structural component admits). delta = null: estimate it with `calibrate` from repeated base evaluations. policy_temperature is passed to the frozen driver (null = endpoint default). heldout_k / heldout_k_endpoints: trials per held-out task for every candidate and incumbent / for the base and final incumbent (verify/, experiment E1).
